name: flow
description: Conversational, spec-driven development workflow for Claude Code: skills that implement specs and manage a backlog (/flow:run), hunt opportunities (/flow:hunt), review docs/PRs/live UI (/flow:review, /flow:pr, /flow:validate), plus independent sub-agents that judge the spec before it is built and the diff before it integrates, and always-on hooks that enforce the spec + commit format.
